components.validation_reason: Depends on Zendesk App Framework hosting configuration assumption ASM_03.
components.name: Zendesk Sidebar Application Host
components.purpose: Serves static web assets for the embedded Zendesk sidebar interface directly to agent browsers.
components.rationale: Amazon CloudFront delivers low-latency static content delivery with HTTPS security.
trade_offs: Requires separate backend API endpoints for dynamic data fetching.
components.security_considerations: Enforces HTTPS TLS encryption for all static asset deliveries.

components.name: Core Agent Assist Backend Service
components.purpose: Orchestrates draft generation, classification, and retrieval workflows for agent requests.
components.rationale: Containerized deployment on Amazon ECS allows simple operational management for a small team.
trade_offs: Requires container management compared to serverless functions.
components.security_considerations: Runs inside private VPC subnets with IAM task roles.

components.validation_reason: Depends on Zendesk JWT authentication setup assumption ASM_03.
components.name: Integration API Gateway
components.purpose: Exposes secure REST APIs to the Zendesk sidebar app and incoming webhooks.
components.rationale: Provides managed API management, rate limiting, and request validation.
trade_offs: Payload size limit of 10 MB per request.
components.security_considerations: Validates JWT tokens and protects endpoints using AWS WAF.

components.name: Operational Relational Database
components.purpose: Stores 24-month audit logs of model invocations, draft attributions, and evaluation metrics in the EU region.
components.rationale: Provides high availability, automatic scaling, and strong compliance capabilities in EU regions.
trade_offs: Higher operational cost than single-instance RDS database.
components.security_considerations: Enforces KMS encryption at rest and restricts network access to private subnets.

components.validation_reason: Requires validation of existing IdP federation configuration.
components.name: Enterprise Identity Service
components.purpose: Manages identity federation and application access permissions for support personnel.
components.rationale: Provides centralized SSO integration and IAM role mapping.
trade_offs: Requires configuration of external IdP trust relationship.
components.security_considerations: Enforces multi-factor authentication and role-based access control.

components.name: Ingestion Event Bus
components.purpose: Routes scheduled ingestion triggers and webhook notifications to ingestion workflows.
components.rationale: Serverless event router with native integration to AWS orchestration services.
trade_offs: Requires event schema management across multiple producers.
components.security_considerations: Enforces event schema validation and encrypted event delivery.

components.name: Multi-Source Data Ingestion Orchestrator
components.purpose: Coordinates bi-weekly data extraction from Zendesk, Confluence, GitHub, and SharePoint.
components.rationale: Manages complex workflow states, error handling, and retry policies without custom code.
trade_offs: Execution duration limits require breaking large jobs into batches.
components.security_considerations: Securely retrieves API credentials from Secrets Manager over PrivateLink.

components.name: Enterprise Vector and Hybrid Search Index
components.purpose: Indexes documentation and past ticket resolutions for hybrid semantic search and retrieval.
components.rationale: Supports vector embeddings and keyword search with metadata filtering for deprecation rules.
trade_offs: Requires cluster sizing management and index tuning.
components.security_considerations: Hosted within VPC with KMS encryption for vector indices.

components.name: EU-Resident Foundation Language Models
components.purpose: Provides foundation model inference for draft replies, classification, and priority suggestions.
components.rationale: Fully managed model endpoints in EU region with strict zero data retention and non-training guarantees.
trade_offs: Subject to regional API quotas and throughput limits.
components.security_considerations: Data is not stored or used for model training; processing occurs within EU boundary.

components.name: PII Redaction and Content Safety Filter
components.purpose: Redacts PII, credentials, and hostnames from prompts before foundation model invocation.
components.rationale: Automated real-time safety and redaction policies natively integrated with Bedrock.
trade_offs: May introduce minor latency overhead to inference requests.
components.security_considerations: Ensures sensitive customer data never reaches external model contexts.

components.name: Application Telemetry and Monitoring
components.purpose: Collects logs, metrics, trace data, and latency dashboards across all solution components.
components.rationale: Centralized AWS monitoring service providing automated alerting and structured log storage.
trade_offs: Requires structured logging standards to optimize log analytics cost.
components.security_considerations: Log groups are encrypted at rest using KMS and retention policies are enforced.

components.name: Secrets and Cryptographic Key Management
components.purpose: Stores API keys, database credentials, and integration tokens with automated rotation.
components.rationale: Managed secrets storage with automatic rotation and KMS encryption integration.
trade_offs: Monthly secret retention and API request costs.
components.security_considerations: Access restricted via fine-grained IAM policies and audit logged in CloudTrail.

components.validation_reason: Recommended to support container runtime pipeline.
components.name: Container Image Registry
components.purpose: Stores and scans container images for the backend services.
components.rationale: Managed container registry with built-in vulnerability scanning.
trade_offs: Requires image lifecycle policies to clean up old image layers.
components.security_considerations: Scans images on push for vulnerability exposure.

components.name: Centralized Infrastructure Configuration
components.purpose: Provides Infrastructure as Code templates for consistent environment provisioning.
components.rationale: Standard AWS infrastructure provisioning tool ensuring parity across dev, test, and prod.
trade_offs: Template drift management requires disciplined deployment pipelines.
components.security_considerations: Enforces IaC policy checks and resource tagging standards.

components.name: Application Gateway WAF
components.purpose: Protects public API endpoints from web exploits and unauthorized traffic.
components.rationale: Managed web application firewall integrating seamlessly with API Gateway and CloudFront.
trade_offs: Rule management requires periodic evaluation to avoid false positives.
components.security_considerations: Blocks common web attacks, SQL injection, and rate limits incoming IP traffic.

components.name: Automated Cloud Backup Manager
components.purpose: Automates centralized backup retention for relational databases and configuration stores within EU.
components.rationale: Centralized backup policy management for AWS services meeting regulatory compliance.
trade_offs: Storage retention costs for long-term audit snapshots.
components.security_considerations: Backups are encrypted using KMS and protected against deletion via vault lock.

environments.dev: Development environment uses dedicated AWS accounts in the EU region with synthetic ticket datasets and scaled-down cluster configurations.
environments.test: Test environment mirrors production in structure using anonymized evaluation datasets to validate benchmark accuracy before release.
environments.prod: Production environment is deployed in primary EU multi-AZ accounts with strict access controls and full multi-region readiness.

deployment_runtime.text: Containerized microservices are deployed via AWS Fargate on Amazon ECS across multiple availability zones. CI/CD pipelines automate image building to ECR and deployment infrastructure using AWS CloudFormation.

availability_scalability.text: The backend utilizes Application Auto Scaling on ECS containers to dynamically handle peak loads of 280 tickets per day. Amazon Aurora and OpenSearch scale automatically to sustain sub-4-second response times during demand surges.

backup_dr.text: AWS Backup enforces daily automated snapshot policies for Aurora PostgreSQL and OpenSearch within the designated EU region. Point-in-time recovery ensures 24-month audit log retention compliance.

observability.text: Amazon CloudWatch logs API execution metrics, generation latency, and citation tracking for quality governance. Real-time dashboards track draft accuracy and audit log retention across all 24 months.

security_controls.text: Amazon Bedrock Guardrails redacts PII and credentials prior to model invocation, ensuring compliance with strict EU data residency. Secrets Manager and KMS manage encrypted authentication tokens without model training on customer data.
